articles.summary: San Rafael, CA: The Board of Directors of Westamerica Bancorporation (NASDAQ: WABC) today declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.46 per share on common stock outstanding to shareholders of record at the close of business August 4, 2025. The dividend is payable August 15, 2025.
